Package io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.result

Class MatchFilter

java.lang.Object
io.github.jspinak.brobot.action.result.MatchFilter
public class MatchFilter extends Object
Provides filtering operations for match collections. Static utility methods for common filtering patterns.

This class extracts filtering operations that were previously embedded in ActionResult.

Since:
2.0
